_note:
⛔ SNG-521. THE SUNK ASSAY, LEVEL 2 — THE ANSWERING EQUIPMENT. Typed soak carried by ITEMS.
⚠️ CCODE, SNG-515: 'typed soak works today via authored `soakLayers[].type` — just not from a ward craft. Her hazards can be typed and answered right now if the answering comes from EQUIPMENT AND SHEETS rather than standing wards.'
⛔ AND NO ITEM IN THE GAME CARRIED A soakLayer — 16 items, none typed. These are the first. ⚠️ WHICH IS THE SAME GAP AS `wardTypes` ONE LAYER OVER: the reader existed, nothing fed it.
_designRule: ⛔ THE PARTY FINDS THE ANSWER IN THE ROOM. Every one of these is recoverable on Level 1 or Level 2 itself. ⚠️ A party does not need to have brought the right tradition — which is what makes the level fair to a group with no Ashwarden and no Lattice.

items.name: Oiled Leathers
items.description: A Greyhearth reckoner's working habit — waxed, doubled at the cuff, and smelling of the stuff they treat it with. It is not armour. It is what you wear so the damp does not get into you.
items._why: ⛔ THE ANSWER TO THE GREY DAMP. ⚠️ AND THE LESSON IS IN THE SECOND LAYER: physical 1. It is nearly useless in a fight, and a party that treats it as armour will be disappointed on Level 3.
items._foundAt: ⚠️ Worn by every Grave-Caller on Level 1. Taken from one, or bought in Greyhearth for the asking.

items.name: A Lattice-Token
items.description: A palm-sized precursor blank, unmarked, warm on one face. Hold it and the assay-light goes through you as though you had already been measured.
items._why: ⛔ THE ANSWER TO THE ASSAY-LIGHT, and the only thing on Level 2 that answers `precursor` at all. ⚠️ IT ANSWERS NOTHING ELSE — a party holding one and nothing else drowns, rots or is throttled by the green.
items._foundAt: ⛔ On the foreman, Level 1. He will trade it — he does not know what it is worth here.

items.name: Cut Stone and Salt
items.description: A satchel of dressed chips and a twist of coarse salt. Mason's leavings. Scatter it and the green will not cross — it has nothing to put roots into and it does not like the salt.
items._why: ⛔ THE ANSWER TO THE DROWNED GREEN — and it is CONSUMABLE, so a party must decide where to spend it. ⚠️ THIS IS THE ITEM THAT MAKES LEVEL 2 A ROUTE PROBLEM RATHER THAN A GEAR CHECK.
items._foundAt: ⚠️ Anywhere a mason has worked. There is a broken pallet of it on Level 1, in the room with the readers.

items.name: A Gantry Line
items.description: Forty feet of assay-works cable, still on its drum. Heavier than rope and it does not rot.
items._why: ⛔ NO SOAK — IT IS A ROUTE, NOT A DEFENCE. ⚠️ With Skydancer r3 it is a crossing for the whole party; without it, the long way and rounds lost to the clock.
items._foundAt: On the collapsing gantry, which is the hazard it answers.

items.name: A Greyhearth Reckoner's Tools
items.description: Probe, lamp, chalk, a short iron rule. The kit for telling what is failing and how long it has.
items._why: ⛔ GRANTS A CRAFT TO A BEARER WHO LACKS IT — Attunement's ashwarden reading, which is what tells you the damp is `decay` before it costs you. ⚠️ TESTS THAT A GRANTED CRAFT BEHAVES LIKE A LEARNED ONE, which nothing in the game currently checks.
items._foundAt: ⚠️ Level 1, on the reader watching the stair.

the_grey_damp._note: ⛔ CARRIES `ongoingHarm: decay` — A WOUND TAKEN HERE DOES NOT CLOSE until the condition is lifted. ⚠️ THE FIRST PLACE A HEALER MUST END A CONDITION BEFORE MENDING, and the party will find that out by failing. Physician's Tome r1 — 'name what is actually wrong' — becomes the correct play.

the_assay_light._note: ⚠️ NO PHYSICAL WARD TOUCHES IT. Armour is irrelevant and a party will try armour first.

the_drowned_green._note: ⛔ A SHIELD DOES NOTHING. It is not striking you; it is growing through you.

the_collapsing_gantry._note: ⚠️ THE ONE HAZARD ARMOUR ANSWERS — and Unmoving Mind does not, because a still mind does not stop a spar.

_theClock: ⛔ THE WATER RISES AS A STANDING EFFECT WITH AN ESCALATING VALUE — CCode's recommendation over a new round clock, since effects already tick per turn and surface on the receipt. ⚠️ THE PLAYER SEES IT EVERY ROUND WITHOUT NEW MACHINERY.
